Regional-absent taxa for Novgorod land ~1230 (not native / introduced later): larch and fir (global landscape templates list them; natural range is east/north-east of the region — C, needs flora-domain confirmation), muskrat (introduced to USSR 20th c.), raccoon dog (introduced 20th c.), American mink (20th c.), Sosnowsky's hogweed (20th c.), Canadian waterweed (19th c.), lilac and horse chestnut (introduced later).
note: Terms are matched as word-initial prefixes (Cyrillic-aware); a trailing ! means exact whole word.
